description: SSH terminal, SFTP and FTPS file manager, RDP client and VNC viewer in one app.
notes: Update Conchshell with 'scoop update conchshell'. Conchshell sees that Scoop installed it and does not install new versions itself: when one is out, it says so and leaves the update to Scoop. To stop its own check for a new version at launch, switch off Settings > Advanced > Check for Updates.
Settings, saved connections and the vault live in %APPDATA%\app.conchshell and %LOCALAPPDATA%\app.conchshell; 'scoop uninstall' leaves them in place.
Conchshell needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime. Windows 11 includes it; if Conchshell does not start on Windows 10, install it from https://developer.microsoft.com/microsoft-edge/webview2/
